blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon. The defense team of former President Rodrigo Duterte has opposed the prosecution’s bid to have two witness testimonies admitted as evidence in his crimes against humanity case before the International Criminal Court. The defense is challenging the move as proceedings continue in The Hague. Meanwhile, Nancy dela Rosa, wife of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, has appealed to influential figures to stop what she described as the persecution of her husband. In another news, Sen.
